page.content:
Mami — Judgment Day enforcer and women's world champion.

How Rhea Ripley connects

  • Faction: Judgment Day — Rhea Ripley became the on-screen center of Judgment Day.
  • Item: WWE Women's Championship — Rhea Ripley held the women's world title as Judgment Day's Mami.

What is Rhea Ripley?

Rhea Ripley came through NXT UK and NXT into the main roster, leading later Judgment Day chapters and holding the women's world title as a dominant heel.

Key threads lead to Judgment Day and WWE Women's Championship.
